40015820.author: पदार्थः
40015820.content: ततः thereafter, द्याम् at the sky, पृथिवींचैव on the ground, वीक्षमाणा seeing, वनौकसः Vanara leaders, बाणैः arrows, सन्ततौ, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, ददृशुः saw.

40015820.author: Translation
40015820.content: Thereafter looking at the sky and the ground for Rama and Lakshmana, the Vanara leaders saw the two brothers, lying on the ground hurt by arrows.

40015821.author: पदार्थः
40015821.content: देवे cloud, वृष्टवेव after raining, राक्षसे Rakshasa, कृतकर्मणि having completed the task, उपरते retired, अथ and then, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, तंदेशम् that location, आजगाम reached.

40015821.author: Translation
40015821.content: Indrajith retired after completing the task, like a cloud that retires after raining. Then came Vibheeshana and Sugriva to that location.

40015822.author: पदार्थः
40015822.content: नीलश्च Neela and, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, सुषेणः Sushena, कुमुदः Kumuda, अङ्गदा: Angada, हनुमतासार्धम् accompanied by Hanuman, तूर्णम् intensely, राघवौ Ragahavas, अन्वशोचन्त grieved looking at.

40015822.author: Translation
40015822.content: Neela, Dwivida, Mainda, Sushena, Kumuda, Angada accompanied by Hanuman grieved intensely on looking at the Raghavas.

40015823.author: पदार्थः
40015823.content: अचेष्टौ unable to move, मन्दनिश्श्वासौ with feeble breath, शोणितौघ drenched in blood, परिप्लुतौ covered all over, शरजालाचितौ with arrows, स्तब्दौ motionless, शयानौ on bed, शरतल्पयोः of arrows, सर्पौयथा like serpents, निश्श्वसन्तौ feeble breath, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, मन्दचेष्टितौ inactive, रुधिरस्राद्विग्धाङ्गौ drenched in blood, तापनीयौ distressed, ध्वजौइव like posts, वीरशयने heroic bed, शयानौ lying, वीरौ heroes, मन्दविक्रमौ prowess reduced, बाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः eyes filled with tears, स्सैः breath, यूथपैः army, परिवृतौ surrounded by, शरजालसमावृतौ network of arrows, तौराघवौ both the scions, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः Vibheeshana, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः appeared.

40015823.author: Translation
40015823.content: Unable to move, with feeble breath, drenched in blood and the body covered all over with arrows, lying on a bed of arrows, stunned, with reduced prowess, sighing like serpents, the heroes, Rama, and Lakshmana, who were like golden posts became dull. Rama and Lakshmana were lying on a heroic bed, arrows stuck to the bodies. Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras kept seeing both the scions and wept surrounding them.

40015824.author: पदार्थः
40015824.content: अचेष्टौ unable to move, मन्दनिश्श्वासौ with feeble breath, शोणितौघ drenched in blood, परिप्लुतौ covered all over, शरजालाचितौ with arrows, स्तब्दौ motionless, शयानौ on bed, शरतल्पयोः of arrows, सर्पौयथा like serpents, निश्श्वसन्तौ feeble breath, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, मन्दचेष्टितौ inactive, रुधिरस्राद्विग्धाङ्गौ drenched in blood, तापनीयौ distressed, ध्वजौइव like posts, वीरशयने heroic bed, शयानौ lying, वीरौ heroes, मन्दविक्रमौ prowess reduced, बाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः eyes filled with tears, स्सैः breath, यूथपैः army, परिवृतौ surrounded by, शरजालसमावृतौ network of arrows, तौराघवौ both the scions, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः Vibheeshana, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः appeared.

40015824.content: Unable to move, with feeble breath, drenched in blood and the body covered all over with arrows, lying on a bed of arrows, stunned, with reduced prowess, sighing like serpents, the heroes, Rama, and Lakshmana, who were like golden posts became dull. Rama and Lakshmana were lying on a heroic bed, arrows stuck to the bodies. Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras kept seeing both the scions and wept surrounding them.

40015825.author: पदार्थः
40015825.content: अचेष्टौ unable to move, मन्दनिश्श्वासौ with feeble breath, शोणितौघ drenched in blood, परिप्लुतौ covered all over, शरजालाचितौ with arrows, स्तब्दौ motionless, शयानौ on bed, शरतल्पयोः of arrows, सर्पौयथा like serpents, निश्श्वसन्तौ feeble breath, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, मन्दचेष्टितौ inactive, रुधिरस्राद्विग्धाङ्गौ drenched in blood, तापनीयौ distressed, ध्वजौइव like posts, वीरशयने heroic bed, शयानौ lying, वीरौ heroes, मन्दविक्रमौ prowess reduced, बाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः eyes filled with tears, स्सैः breath, यूथपैः army, परिवृतौ surrounded by, शरजालसमावृतौ network of arrows, तौराघवौ both the scions, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः Vibheeshana, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः appeared.

40015826.author: पदार्थः
40015826.content: अचेष्टौ unable to move, मन्दनिश्श्वासौ with feeble breath, शोणितौघ drenched in blood, परिप्लुतौ covered all over, शरजालाचितौ with arrows, स्तब्दौ motionless, शयानौ on bed, शरतल्पयोः of arrows, सर्पौयथा like serpents, निश्श्वसन्तौ feeble breath, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, मन्दचेष्टितौ inactive, रुधिरस्राद्विग्धाङ्गौ drenched in blood, तापनीयौ distressed, ध्वजौइव like posts, वीरशयने heroic bed, शयानौ lying, वीरौ heroes, मन्दविक्रमौ prowess reduced, बाष्पव्याकुललोचनैः eyes filled with tears, स्सैः breath, यूथपैः army, परिवृतौ surrounded by, शरजालसमावृतौ network of arrows, तौराघवौ both the scions, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः Vibheeshana, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः appeared.

40015826.content: Unable to move, with feeble breath, drenched in blood and the body covered all over with arrows, lying on a bed of arrows, stunned, with reduced prowess, sighing like serpents, the heroes, Rama, and Lakshmana, who were like golden posts became dull. Rama and Lakshmana were lying on a heroic bed, arrows stuck to the bodies. Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras kept seeing both the scions and wept surrounding them.

40015827.author: पदार्थः
40015827.content: अन्तरिक्षम् sky, सर्वाः all over, दिशश्च directions, निरीक्षन्तः looking, वानराः Vanaras, रणे battle, मायया mystical power, चैनं not find, छन्नम् searched, एनम् all over, रावणिम् Indrajith, ददृशुः could not see.

40015827.author: Translation
40015827.content: Though the Vanaras searched all over the battlefield and in all directions of the sky, they could not see Indrajith of mystical powers.

40015828.author: पदार्थः
40015828.content: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, माययैव occult, वीक्षमाणः started looking, मायाप्रतिच्छन्नम् searched with occult powers, अथ and then, अवस्थितम् stood, तम् his, भ्रातुःपुत्रम् brother's son, ददर्श saw.

40015828.author: Translation
40015828.content: Vibheeshana started looking with occult powers for his brother's son endowed with occult power following occult means and found Indrajith.

40015829.author: पदार्थः
40015829.content: तेजसा brilliant, यशसाचैव glory, विक्रमेणच capable of difficult deeds, सम्युतम् endowed with, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अप्रतिमकर्माणम् incomparable in his task, आहवे in fight, अप्रतिद्वन्दम् unrivalled in battle, वरदानात् by virtue of a boon, अन्तर्हितम् hidden, तम् him, वीरम् hero, ददर्श seen.

40015829.author: Translation
40015829.content: Brilliant and glorious Vibheeshana, capable of difficult deeds, incomparable at work, and in fight, unrivalled in battle, saw the hidden hero Indrajith by virtue of a boon (from Brahma).

40015830.author: पदार्थः
40015830.content: इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, आत्मनः himself, कर्म action, शयानौ on the bed, तौच both, समीक्ष्य reviewing, परमप्रीतः very happily, सर्वनैरृतान् to all Rakshasas, हर्षयन् making to rejoice, उवाच spoke.

40015830.author: Translation
40015830.content: Reviewing the scions lying on bed by his action, Indrajith caused extreme joy to all Rakshasas and spoke.

40015831.author: पदार्थः
40015831.content: दूषणस्यच Dushana, खरस्यच and Khara, हन्तारौ slayer, महाबलौ very strong, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, मामकैः by my, बाणैः arrows, सादितौ struck.

40015831.author: Translation
40015831.content: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who slayed Dushana and Khara have been struck."

40015832.author: पदार्थः
40015832.content: सर्वैः all, सर्षिसङ्घैः sages, सुरासुरैः Devatas and Rakshasas, समागम्य collected together, इमौ this, एतस्मात् by them, इषुबन्धनात् to rid of this network, मोक्षयितुम् liberate, नशक्यौ not possible.

40015832.author: Translation
40015832.content: "Even if all the sages, Devatas and Rakshasas collected together come, they cannot get liberated from this bondage of arrows."

40015833.author: पदार्थः
40015833.content: यत्कृकते on whose account, चिन्तयानस्य with this thought, शोकार्तस्य is in grief, ममपितुः my father, गात्रैः body, शयनम् bed, अस्पृष्टवा not understood clearly, त्रियामा three periods, शर्वरी night, याति passed away, यत्कृते by what action, कृत्स्ना dark, इयंलङ्का this Lanka, वर्षासु raining, नदीइव like river, आकुला agitated, सः he, अयम् all, सर्वेषाम् all of us, मूलहरः root cause, अनर्थः got rid of, मया by me, निहतः killed.

40015833.author: Translation
40015833.content: "On whose account my father was in grief and spent all night and passed the three parts of the night (without sleep) and why he was unable to sleep was not understood clearly. By his (Rama's) action this Lanka is agitated like a river during the rainy season. He, who is the root cause of this calamity, has been got rid of by me," thought Indrajith.

40015834.author: पदार्थः
40015834.content: यत्कृकते on whose account, चिन्तयानस्य with this thought, शोकार्तस्य is in grief, ममपितुः my father, गात्रैः body, शयनम् bed, अस्पृष्टवा not understood clearly, त्रियामा three periods, शर्वरी night, याति passed away, यत्कृते by what action, कृत्स्ना dark, इयंलङ्का this Lanka, वर्षासु raining, नदीइव like river, आकुला agitated, सः he, अयम् all, सर्वेषाम् all of us, मूलहरः root cause, अनर्थः got rid of, मया by me, निहतः killed.

40015834.author: Translation
40015834.content: "On whose account my father was in grief and spent all night and passed the three parts of the night (without sleep) and why he was unable to sleep was not understood clearly. By his (Rama's) action this Lanka is agitated like a river during the rainy season. He, who is the root cause of this calamity, has been got rid of by me," thought Indrajith.

40015835.author: पदार्थः
40015835.content: रामस्य Rama's, लक्ष्मणस्यैव and even Lakshmana's, सर्वेषाम् everything, वनौकसाम् Vanaras, सर्वे all, विक्रमाः valiant, शरदि autumn, तोयदाःइव like clouds, निष्फलाः wasted.

40015835.author: Translation
40015835.content: "Rama, and Lakshmana and even all valiant Vanaras have been got rid of just like clouds of autumn are wasted."

40015836.author: पदार्थः
40015836.content: सःरावणिः that Indrajith, तान् his, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, परिपार्श्वतः those looking at him, सर्वान् all, यूथपानपि army generals, ताडयामास began to strike.

40015836.author: Translation
40015836.content: Indrajith, having spoken in that way to all Rakshasas, began to strike all the Vanara leaders looking at him.

40015837.author: पदार्थः
40015837.content: अमित्रघ्नः slayer of enemies, च and, नीलम् Neela, नवभिः nine shafts, आहत्य attacking, मैन्दम् Mainda, तथा so also, द्विविदम् Dwivida, त्रिभिःत्रिभिः three and three, प्रवरेषुभिः sharp edged shafts, तताप attacked.

40015837.author: Translation
40015837.content: The slayer of enemies, Indrajith attacked Neela with nine shafts, so also Mainda and Dwivida with three separate sharpedged shafts.

40015838.author: पदार्थः
40015838.content: महेष्वासः endowed with great bow, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, वक्षसि in the chest, बाणेन with shafts, विद् ध्वा pierced, वेगवतः endowed with speed in war, हनूमतः Hanuman, दश ten, शरान् arrows, विससर्ज released.

40015838.author: Translation
40015838.content: Indrajith endowed with great bow pierced Jambavan in his chest, and released ten arrows at Hanuman, endowed with speed in war.

40015839.author: पदार्थः
40015839.content: महावेगः endowed with speed, रावणिः Indrajith, युधि in war, अमिततेजसौ highly energetic, तौ both, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, शरभंचैव Sarabha, द्वाभ्यांद्वाभ्याम् two and two, विव्याध attacked.

40015839.author: Translation
40015839.content: Indrajith endowed with speed in war, attacked highly energetic Gavaksha and Sarabha with two arrows each.

40015840.author: पदार्थः
40015840.content: अथ and then, रावणिः Ravana's son, त्वरमाणः swiftly, गोलाङ्गूलेश्वरम् ruler of Golangulas, अथ and then, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, बहुभिः many, बाणैः arrows, विव्याद pierced.

40015840.author: Translation
40015840.content: Thereafter Indrajith attacked the ruler of Golangulas, and Vali's son Angada with many arrows.

40015841.author: पदार्थः
40015841.content: बलवान् mighty, महासत्त्व: strong, सःरावणिः that son of Ravana, तत्र there, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, शरैः shafts, तान् himself, वानरवरान् best of monkeys, भित्त्वा attacked, ननाद and roared.

40015841.author: Translation
40015841.content: Mighty son of Ravana, then attacked the best of monkeys with arrows which were like flames of fire.

40015842.author: पदार्थः
40015842.content: तान् Indrajith, बाणौघैः hails of arrows, अर्धयित्वा struck, वानरान् Vanaras, त्रासयित्वाच terrifying, महाबाहुः of strong arms, प्रजहास laughing, इदम् these, वचनंच words, अब्रवीत् spoken.

40015842.author: Translation
40015842.content: Indrajith hurt the Vanaras with hails of arrows terrifying them. Then the mighty armed son of Ravana laughed and spoke these words.

40015843.author: पदार्थः
40015843.content: राक्षसाः Rakshasas, घोरेण terrible, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, चमूमुखे in the forefront, मया by me, बद्धौ bound, सहितौ together, एतौभ्रातरौ these two brothers, निशामयत fallen.

40015843.author: Translation
40015843.content: "O Rakshasas! Look at these two brothers together bound by my fierce arrows in front of you."

40015844.author: पदार्थः
40015844.content: एवम् in that way, उक्ताः having said, कूटयोधिनः cheerful, ते they, सर्वेराक्षसाः all Rakshasas, तेनकर्मणा by that action, परम् extremely, विस्मयम् amazed, आजग्मुः went, हर्षिताः laughing.

40015844.author: Translation
40015844.content: Indrajith having spoken in that way to the Rakshasas, all of them were highly amazed by the action of Indrajith and went laughing.

40015845.author: पदार्थः
40015845.content: जलदोपमाः like clouds, तेसर्वे all of them, महानादान् roaring aloud, विनेदुः joyfully, रामः Rama, हतःइति is killed, ज्ञात्वा thinking, रावणिम् Son of Ravana, समपूजयन् offered prayers.

40015845.author: Translation
40015845.content: The Rakshasas thundering like rain clouds, roaring aloud thinking 'Rama is killed' by Ravana's son offered prayers.

40015846.author: पदार्थः
40015846.content: तदा thereafter, निष्पन्दौ not responding, निरुच्छवासौ without breathing, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, वसुधायाम् on the ground, दृष्टवा having seen, हताविति dead, अन्वमन्यत thought.

40015846.author: Translation
40015846.content: Thereafter having seen the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana not responding or breathing, lying on the ground, he thought they were dead.

40015847.author: पदार्थः
40015847.content: समितिञ्जयः one who is victorious in battles, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, हर्षेण felt happy, समाविष्टः collected there, सर्वनैर्वतान् for all Rakshasas, हर्षयन् creating happiness, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, प्रविवेश entered

40015847.author: Translation
40015847.content: Indrajith, who is victorious in battles, feeling happy and creating happiness to all Rakshasas collected there entered the city of Lanka.

40015848.author: पदार्थः
40015848.content: रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, सायकैः by arrows, चिते riddled with, शरीरे body, सर्वाणि all over, अङ्गोपाङ्गानि from head to foot, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भयम् feared, आविशत् possessed.

40015848.author: Translation
40015848.content: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body

40015849.author: पदार्थः
40015849.content: रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, सायकैः by arrows, चिते riddled with, शरीरे body, सर्वाणि all over, अङ्गोपाङ्गानि from head to foot, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भयम् feared, आविशत् possessed.

40015849.author: Translation
40015849.content: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body

40015850.author: पदार्थः
40015850.content: रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, सायकैः by arrows, चिते riddled with, शरीरे body, सर्वाणि all over, अङ्गोपाङ्गानि from head to foot, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भयम् feared, आविशत् possessed.

40015850.author: Translation
40015850.content: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body

40015851.author: पदार्थः
40015851.content: रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, सायकैः by arrows, चिते riddled with, शरीरे body, सर्वाणि all over, अङ्गोपाङ्गानि from head to foot, दृष्टवा seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, भयम् feared, आविशत् possessed.

40015851.author: Translation
40015851.content: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body

40015852.author: पदार्थः
40015852.content: वानर Vanara, आत्मानम् our self, अनाथम् helpless, मांच and mine, पर्यमास्थापय restoring, सत्यधर्मानिरक्तानाम् for those following righteousness and truthfulness, मृत्युकृतम् from death, भयम् fear, नास्ति not.

40015852.author: Translation
40015852.content: "O Vanara! We are helpless, be confident, for those following righteousness and truthfulness there is no fear of death."

40015853.author: पदार्थः
40015853.content: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा spoken, ततः then, जलक्लिन्नेन dipping in water, पाणिना hand, तस्यसुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, शुभे beautiful, नेत्रे eyes, प्रममार्ज brightened.

40015853.author: Translation
40015853.content: Vibheeshana, having spoken in that manner, there after dipped his hand in water and wiped the beautiful eyes of Sugriva to brighten.

40015854.author: पदार्थः
40015854.content: ततः thereafter, धर्मात्मा dutiful, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सलिलम् water, आदाय taking, विद्यया as per tradition, परिजस्यच chanting sacred text to consecrate, सुग्रीवनेत्रे Sugriva's eyes, सममार्ज wiped.

40015854.author: Translation
40015854.content: Thereafter the dutiful Vibheeshana taking water as per tradition consecrated chanting sacred text and wiped Sugriva's eyes.

40015855.author: पदार्थः
40015855.content: धीमतः wise, तस्यकपिराजस्य that monkey king, वदनम् countenance, विमृज्य wiped clean, कालसम्प्राप्तम् as per that time, असम्भ्रान्तम् opportune, इदंवचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40015855.author: Translation
40015855.content: Wise Vibheeshana having wiped Sugriva's face clean in accordance with time addressed with opportune words.

40015856.author: पदार्थः
40015856.content: कपिराजेन्द्र monkey king, वैक्लब्यम् faint heartedness, अवलम्बितुम् to follow, कालः time, न not this, अस्मिन् our, काले time, अतिस्नेहोऽप्य with extreme attachment, मरणाय death, उपकल्पते lead.

40015856.author: Translation
40015856.content: "O king of monkeys! This is not the time for faint heartedness. Extreme attachment at this time will lead us to death."

40015857.author: पदार्थः
40015857.content: तस्मात् therefore, सर्वकार्यविनाशनम् all actions will be destroyed, वैक्लब्यम् faintheartedness, उत्सृज्य give up, रामपुरोगणाम् following Rama, सैन्यानाम् army, हितम् welfare, अनुचिन्त्यताम् think of.

40015857.author: Translation
40015857.content: "Therefore, give up faintheartedness as all actions will be destroyed by that. Following Rama's leadership, think of the army's welfare."

40015858.author: पदार्थः
40015858.content: अथवा or else, यावत्संज्ञाविपर्ययः till they become conscious, रामः Rama, रक्ष्यताम् protect, लब्धसंज्ञौ when they get back consciousness, काकुत्स्थौ both Kakuthsa princes, नौ, भयम् fear, व्यपनेष्यतःहि will be able to get rid off.

40015858.author: Translation
40015858.content: "Or else till they become conscious, protect the Kakuthsa princes. When they become conscious, they can get rid of our fear."

40015859.author: पदार्थः
40015859.content: एतत् therefore, रामस्य Rama's, किञ्चन even a little, न not, रामः Rama, नमुमूर्षति not going to die, या whatever, गतायुषाम् life is lost, दुर्लभा difficult, लक्ष्मीः prosperous, एनम् , नहास्यतेहि not leave him.

40015859.author: Translation
40015859.content: "Therefore, Rama has no fear of death, even a little. Whatever splendour is lost, prosperity will not leave him."

40015860.author: पदार्थः
40015860.content: तस्मात् therefore, आत्मानम् ourselves, आश्वासय restoring breath, स्वकम् myself, बलम् army, आश्वासय reassure, अहम् I, सर्वाणि all, कार्यानि actions, पुनः again, यावत् संस्थापयामि all the army restore confidence.

40015860.author: Translation
40015860.content: "Therefore, restoring breath let us reassure the army again till all actions are carried out by restoring their confidence."

40015861.author: पदार्थः
40015861.content: हरिसत्तम monkey leader, एते these, हरयः monkeys, फुल्लनयनाः dilated eyes, त्रासात् by fear, आगतसाध्वसाः seized with fear, कर्णेकर्णे ear to ear, प्रकथिताः talking to each other.

40015861.author: Translation
40015861.content: "O Monkey leader! these monkeys whose eyes have become big (are dilated) with fear are talking ear to ear (about Rama)."

40015862.author: पदार्थः
40015862.content: अनीकम् army forces, सम्प्रहर्षितुम् made them happy, प्रधावन्तम् inherent, माम् me, दृष्टवा seeing, हरयः monkeys, त्रासम् moving in fear, भुक्तपूर्वम् enjoyed earlier, स्रजम् garland of flowers, इव like that, त्यजन्तु discard.

40015862.author: Translation
40015862.content: "Let the army forces of monkeys be happy seeing me moving, getting rid of the inherent fear in them just as they discard a garland of flowers enjoyed by them earlier."

40015863.author: पदार्थः
40015863.content: राक्षसेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, समाश्वास्य assured, विद्रुतम् knowing, तत् वानरानीकम् that Vanara army, पुनः again, समाश्वासयत् reassured.

40015863.author: Translation
40015863.content: The king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana having assured Sugriva, knowing the Vanara army he reassured them.

40015864.author: पदार्थः
40015864.content: महामायः great, इन्द्रजित्तुः Indrajith, सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः all the army surrounding him, लङ्कां Lanka नगरीम् City, विवेश entered, पितरम् father, अभ्युपागमत् च approached.

40015864.author: Translation
40015864.content: Great Indrajith surrounded by all army entered the city of Lanka and approached his father.

40015865.author: पदार्थः
40015865.content: तत्र there, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having reached, अभिवाद्य greeted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, निहतौ are killed, पित्रे O father, प्रियम् dear, आचचक्षे broke the news.

40015865.author: Translation
40015865.content: Having reached Ravana, Indrajith greeted him with folded palms and broke the pleasant news, "Rama and Lakshmana are killed."

40015866.author: पदार्थः
40015866.content: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, मध्ये midst, रावणः Ravana, शत्रू enemy, निपातितौ killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, ततः then, हृष्टः rejoiced, उत्पपात got up, पुत्रम् son, पर्षिस्वजेच embraced

40015866.author: Translation
40015866.content: In the midst of Rakshasas, Ravana hearing the news of his enemies being killed, rejoiced, and got up from his couch and embraced his son.

40015867.author: पदार्थः
40015867.content: पृच्छते enquired, पित्रे father, तौ both of them, शरबन्धेन from the network of arrows, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, निष्प्रभौ splendour gone, यथा like that, कृतौ did, तस्मै their, यथावृत्तम् all in detail, न्यवेदयत् presented.

40015867.author: Translation
40015867.content: Delighted Ravana kissed his son on the forehead and enquired of him of the details. Indrajith presented details saying that both Rama and Lakshmana were stunned in the network of arrows, and lost splendour.

40015868.author: पदार्थः
40015868.content: पृच्छते enquired, पित्रे father, तौ both of them, शरबन्धेन from the network of arrows, निश्चेष्टौ stunned, निष्प्रभौ splendour gone, यथा like that, कृतौ did, तस्मै their, यथावृत्तम् all in detail, न्यवेदयत् presented.

40015868.author: Translation
40015868.content: Delighted Ravana kissed his son on the forehead and enquired of him of the details. Indrajith presented details saying that both Rama and Lakshmana were stunned in the network of arrows, and lost splendour.

40015869.author: पदार्थः
40015869.content: महारथस्य of the great chariot warrior, तस्य his, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हर्षवेगानुगतान्तरात्मा filled with joy at heart, सः he, दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son, समुत्थितम् fear, ज्वरम् agony, जहौ gone, प्रहृष्यवाचा joyful words, पुत्रम् son, अभिननन्द greeted.

40015869.author: Translation
40015869.content: Hearing the words of the great chariot warrior, Ravana was filled with excessive joy at heart. His fear and agony of Dasaratha's son having gone on hearing the words of his son, Ravana greeted him. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
